name: AnalyticsDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/AnalyticsDashboard
summary: The analytics dashboard pattern: KPI tiles, charts and a table that all read the same period, so one change of range moves every region together. A row of four StatTiles (requests, data transferred, success rate and status 5xx, each with a sparkline and its change against the previous period) sits over a 12-column grid of ChartCards. Requests over time spans the grid as an area Chart, status codes as a multi-series line and requests by country as labeled horizontal bars share a row, and a searchable, paginated TableRoot of top hosts closes it. Every card carries the same header: title with a Hint, the aggregation and variation Tags, a Line or Bar ToggleGroup for time series, an Expand IconButton, and a DropdownMenu with Copy query and Export CSV. Built from `PageHeader`, `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `TableRoot`, `Tag`, `Hint`, `ToggleGroup`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, `Input` and `EmptyState`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the first response loads, every tile, chart and the table hold their place with a Skeleton, so the grid does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No traffic in the period. The tiles show a dash with no delta or trend, and each card keeps its box with an EmptyState that says nothing was recorded.
